name: youtube-agent
description: YouTube scripting, packaging, editing, comments, planning, trend research, retention, Shorts, SEO, chapters and channel audits.

interface.longDescription: Eleven YouTube workflows: script and hook writing; title and thumbnail packaging; transcript-based edit decisions; comment replies; content planning; viral-video research; audience-retention analysis; Shorts selection; video SEO; chapters; and channel audits. Includes six local analysis utilities when Python and file execution are available. Uses supplied materials or accessible public information; it does not upload videos, post comments, or access private YouTube analytics automatically. Adapted from Jake Schincariol's MIT-licensed youtube-agent-skill.
defaultPrompt: Help me script my next YouTube video.
Review my title and thumbnail together.

prompts: Write five hook options for a video about beginner gardening.
Review these title and thumbnail ideas together.
Analyze this retention export and identify the largest drop.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with eleven YouTube creator workflows.
